title: Emergent Reciprocity and Team Formation from Randomized Uncertain Social Preferences
reasoning: The paper investigates Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) in game-theoretic social dilemmas like the Prisoner's Dilemma. Although it discusses 'prosocial' behavior and the emergence of cooperation, it is a technical reinforcement learning paper and does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral judgment systems, or ethical frameworks.
